instruction_bn: প্রশ্নগুলোর উত্তর দিয়ে একটি paragraph লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Physical Exercise' answering: (a) What is physical exercise? (b) What are its kinds? (c) What are its benefits? (d) What rules should be followed? (e) What harm does lack of it cause?
items.model: Physical exercise means the regular movement of our limbs and body according to certain rules. It is essential for good health. There are many kinds of physical exercise such as walking, running, swimming, riding and playing games. Walking is the simplest and safest kind, and it suits people of all ages. Physical exercise has many benefits. It keeps our body strong and active and free from diseases. It also refreshes our mind and makes us cheerful. However, some rules should be followed while taking exercise. It should be taken in the open air, preferably in the morning. It should also suit one's age and health. Excessive exercise is harmful. On the other hand, lack of physical exercise makes the body weak and lazy and invites many diseases. As a sound mind lives in a sound body, we should take physical exercise every day.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Floods in Bangladesh' answering: (a) What is a flood? (b) Why does it happen in Bangladesh? (c) What damage does it cause? (d) How do people suffer? (e) What should be done?
items.model: A flood is the overflow of water that submerges a large area of land. Bangladesh is a land of rivers, so floods are a common natural calamity here. Floods happen in our country for several reasons. Heavy rainfall during the monsoon and the sudden rush of water from the hills of India cause the rivers to overflow their banks. A flood causes great damage to us. It destroys crops, houses, roads and cattle. Standing crops are washed away, and people lose their homes and property. During a flood people suffer terribly. They take shelter on high land and pass their days half-fed or unfed. Many suffer from waterborne diseases, and the supply of pure drinking water becomes scarce. To reduce the sufferings of a flood, strong embankments should be built along the rivers. The government and the rich should come forward to help the flood-affected people.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Drug Addiction' answering: (a) What is drug addiction? (b) Why do young people take drugs? (c) What harm does it cause? (d) How does society suffer? (e) How can it be stopped?
items.model: Drug addiction means being habituated to taking harmful drugs. It has become a serious problem, especially among the young generation. There are many reasons behind drug addiction. Frustration, unemployment, family trouble and bad company lead many young people to take drugs. Some take them out of curiosity and then cannot give them up. Drug addiction causes great harm to the addict. It destroys his health, wealth and mental peace and often leads him to death. An addict frequently turns to crimes like theft, robbery and even murder to get money for drugs. In this way society also suffers a lot. To stop drug addiction, we must create awareness among the people. Parents should keep an eye on their children. The government should stop the smuggling of drugs and punish the drug dealers. Only through joint efforts can we save our young generation from this curse.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Postman' answering: (a) Who is a postman? (b) How does he look? (c) What does he do? (d) How does he serve us? (e) How should we treat him?
items.model: A postman is a well-known public servant. He works in the post office and carries our letters and parcels. A postman can be easily known by his dress. He usually wears a khaki uniform and carries a bag full of letters on his shoulder. His main duty is to deliver letters, money orders and parcels from door to door. He goes out in the sun and rain and reaches every corner of the town and village. He brings us news of our near and dear ones living far away. A postman renders great service to society. He connects people with one another. In spite of his hard work, his pay is very small, and he leads a humble life. So, we should be kind and grateful to him. We should not disturb him unnecessarily and should behave gently with him.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Fisherman' answering: (a) Who is a fisherman? (b) Where does he live? (c) What does he do? (d) What problems does he face? (e) How important is he?
items.model: A fisherman is a person who catches fish for his living. He is a familiar figure in a country of rivers like Bangladesh. A fisherman usually lives in a small hut on the bank of a river, a canal or the sea. He is generally very poor. He goes out early in the morning or at night with his net and boat to catch fish. He works hard in the sun, rain and storm. Sometimes he has to stay in the water for hours. A fisherman faces many problems in his life. He often risks his life in the stormy sea and big rivers. He does not get a fair price for his fish, so he can hardly maintain his family. In spite of his hardship, a fisherman is very important to us. He supplies us with fish, which is a main source of protein. So, we should value his labour and help him improve his condition.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Day Labourer' answering: (a) Who is a day labourer? (b) How does he live? (c) What kind of work does he do? (d) What problems does he face? (e) What is his contribution?
items.model: A day labourer is a person who works hard and is paid at the end of the day. He is one of the poorest people in our society. A day labourer lives from hand to mouth in a small hut. He has little education and few possessions. He does all kinds of hard physical work. He works in the field, at construction sites, in brickfields and at markets, carrying loads on his head. He gets up early in the morning and works till evening under the open sky. A day labourer faces many problems in his life. His income is very small, so he cannot meet the basic needs of his family. He suffers most when there is no work or when he falls ill. Yet the contribution of a day labourer is very great. He builds our roads, houses and cities with his hard labour. So, we should respect him and ensure fair wages for him.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'My Favourite Teacher' answering: (a) Who is your favourite teacher? (b) How does he look? (c) How does he teach? (d) What qualities does he have? (e) Why do you like him?
items.model: My favourite teacher is Mr Rahman, who teaches us English. He is a middle-aged man of fair complexion. He is neither too tall nor too short and always wears neat and clean dresses. He is a very good teacher. He teaches us in a simple and interesting way so that even a weak student can understand him easily. He never makes his lessons boring. He has many good qualities. He is punctual, sincere and affectionate to all his students. He loves us like his own children and helps the poor students in every possible way. He never becomes angry without reason. He also advises us to be honest and dutiful in life. I like him very much because of his kind nature and his method of teaching. I consider myself lucky to be his student and shall always remember him with respect.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Cricket Match' answering: (a) When and where did you see it? (b) Which teams played? (c) How was the game? (d) Who won? (e) How did you feel?
items.model: A cricket match is a very exciting game. Last Friday I watched an interesting cricket match between our school team and a neighbouring school team. It was held on our school playground. A large number of spectators gathered there to enjoy the game. The match began at ten in the morning. Our team won the toss and decided to bat first. Our batsmen played very well and scored a good number of runs. After the interval the other team came to bat. Our bowlers bowled brilliantly and took wickets one after another. The game became very exciting towards the end, and everyone watched breathlessly. At last our school team won the match by twenty runs. The spectators clapped and cheered loudly at our victory. I was very happy to see our team win. It was a thrilling match, and I enjoyed every moment of it.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'The Season I Like Most' answering: (a) Which season do you like most? (b) When does it come? (c) How does nature look then? (d) What fruits and flowers are found? (e) Why do you like it?
items.model: Of all the seasons of the year, I like the rainy season most. It is the second season in Bangladesh and comes after summer. It covers the months of Ashar and Sraban, that is, from mid-June to mid-August. In this season the sky often remains cloudy, and it rains almost every day. After the scorching heat of summer, the rain brings a soothing touch to nature. The fields, trees and plants become green and fresh. The rivers and canals become full of water. Many kinds of fruits are found in this season, such as mango, jackfruit and blackberry. Beautiful flowers like kadam and jasmine bloom in the rain. The croaking of frogs and the smell of wet earth fill the air. I like the rainy season most because of its green beauty and the joy of rain. It also gives our farmers plenty of water for cultivation.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Duties of a Good Citizen' answering: (a) Who is a good citizen? (b) What are his duties? (c) What rights does he enjoy? (d) How does he help the country? (e) Why are good citizens needed?
items.model: A good citizen is a person who is aware of his duties and rights and performs them properly. He is an asset to his country. A good citizen has many duties. His first duty is to obey the laws of the land and to pay taxes regularly. He should keep his surroundings clean and take part in social welfare work. He should respect the rights and opinions of others. Along with duties, a good citizen enjoys certain rights, such as the right to education, security and freedom of speech. A good citizen helps his country in many ways. He is honest, dutiful and patriotic. He works for the progress and welfare of the nation. In times of danger he comes forward to serve his country. Good citizens are needed because the progress of a nation depends on them. So, everyone should try to be a good citizen.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Price Hike' answering: (a) What is price hike? (b) What are its causes? (c) How does it affect people? (d) Who suffer most? (e) How can it be controlled?
items.model: Price hike means the sudden and continuous rise in the prices of daily necessaries. It has become a serious problem in our country. There are many causes of price hike. The increase of population, the lack of production and the dishonesty of some businessmen are the main causes. Some greedy traders create an artificial crisis by hoarding goods to earn more money. Price hike affects the life of common people badly. It becomes very hard for them to buy food, clothes and other necessary things. The fixed-income and poor people suffer most from the rise in prices. They cannot maintain their families with their small incomes. Price hike can be controlled in several ways. The government should increase production and ensure a fair distribution of goods. Dishonest traders and hoarders should be strictly punished. The market should also be monitored regularly to keep prices within the reach of the common people.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Digital Bangladesh' answering: (a) What is Digital Bangladesh? (b) What does it mean? (c) How does it help us? (d) In which fields is it used? (e) What is its importance?
items.model: Digital Bangladesh is a dream of building a modern country with the help of information and communication technology. It means running all the activities of the state and society digitally. In a Digital Bangladesh people can get almost every service through computers and the internet. It helps us in countless ways. We can pay bills, book tickets and send money sitting at home. Students can learn many things online and attend virtual classes. Digital technology is now used in almost every field. In education, healthcare, agriculture, business and administration, digital services have made our life easy and fast. Government offices provide many services online, which saves our time and reduces corruption. The importance of Digital Bangladesh is very great. It saves time and labour, increases efficiency and connects the country with the wider world. To make this dream fully successful, we should spread computer education and internet facilities to every corner of the country.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'My Hobby' answering: (a) What is a hobby? (b) What is your hobby? (c) How did you develop it? (d) How do you enjoy it? (e) How is it useful?
items.model: A hobby is a favourite work that one does in one's leisure time for pleasure. Different people have different hobbies. My hobby is gardening. I developed this hobby from my childhood. My father had a small garden beside our house, and I used to help him look after it. Gradually I became fond of it and made a garden of my own. In my leisure time I work in my garden with great pleasure. I water the plants, remove the weeds and put fences around them. I have planted many flower plants and some fruit trees in my garden. When the flowers bloom and the fruits ripen, my heart fills with joy. My hobby is very useful to me. It gives me both pleasure and profit. It keeps my body and mind fresh and teaches me the value of work. It also supplies my family with fresh flowers and fruits.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Railway Station' answering: (a) What is a railway station? (b) How does it look? (c) What is seen there? (d) What happens when a train arrives? (e) How do you feel there?
items.model: A railway station is a place where trains stop to take and drop passengers. It is a busy and crowded place. A railway station has one or more platforms with sheds over them. There is a ticket counter, a waiting room, a bookstall and refreshment stalls. Many people are seen there. Some are buying tickets, some are waiting for the train and others are moving up and down. Porters carry the luggage of the passengers. When a train arrives, the whole station becomes busy and noisy. Passengers hurry to get down or get into the train. Hawkers cry out to sell their goods. There is a great rush at the doors of the compartments. After a few minutes the train blows its whistle and leaves the station. I feel a strange excitement whenever I stand at a railway station. The busy scene of a railway station is really interesting to watch.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Female Education' answering: (a) What is female education? (b) Why is it important? (c) What is its present condition? (d) What are the obstacles? (e) What should be done?
items.model: Female education means the education of girls and women. It is very important for the development of a nation. Women are half of our total population. If they remain uneducated, half of the nation stays backward, and the country cannot go forward. An educated woman can earn her living and help her family. Above all, an educated mother can bring up her children in a proper way. In the past female education was much neglected in our country, but the present condition is much better. Nowadays girls are going to schools and colleges in large numbers, and many of them are doing very well. Still there are some obstacles, such as poverty, early marriage, superstition and social prejudice. To remove these obstacles, we must build public awareness. The government should provide free education and stipends for girls. Then female education will spread, and our nation will surely prosper.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'My Aim in Life' answering: (a) What is aim in life? (b) What is your aim? (c) Why have you chosen it? (d) How will you fulfil it? (e) What will you do after fulfilling it?
items.model: Everybody should have an aim in life. A life without an aim is like a ship without a rudder. I too have an aim in my life. My aim is to be a doctor. There are some strong reasons behind choosing this profession. Our country is a poor and populous country. Many people, especially in the villages, suffer and die for want of proper treatment. I want to serve these poor and helpless people. To fulfil my aim, I am now reading attentively. After passing the HSC examination, I shall get myself admitted into a medical college. I shall study hard there to become a good doctor. After becoming a doctor, I shall go back to my village. I shall set up a clinic there and treat the poor villagers free of cost. Thus I want to serve the suffering humanity and make my life meaningful.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Rickshaw Puller' answering: (a) Who is a rickshaw puller? (b) How does he live? (c) What does he do? (d) What problems does he face? (e) How useful is he?
items.model: A rickshaw puller is a familiar figure in our towns and cities. He is a poor man who earns his living by pulling a rickshaw. He generally lives in a slum or a small rented room. He is usually poorly dressed and poorly fed. A rickshaw puller works very hard from morning till night. He carries passengers from one place to another in exchange for money. He pulls his rickshaw in the sun and rain and often has to wait for passengers. A rickshaw puller faces many problems in his life. His income is small and uncertain. He suffers a lot when he falls ill or when there are few passengers. His body becomes weak because of hard labour and poor food. Yet a rickshaw puller is very useful to us. He carries us quickly and cheaply through the narrow lanes. So, we should be kind to him and pay him his fair fare.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Load Shedding' answering: (a) What is load shedding? (b) Why does it happen? (c) How does it affect students? (d) How does it affect industry? (e) How can it be reduced?
items.model: Load shedding means the sudden stoppage of the supply of electricity for some time. It is a common problem in our country, especially in summer. Load shedding happens when the demand for electricity is greater than its production. System loss, misuse of power and the shortage of power plants are the main causes behind it. Load shedding affects the students most. They cannot study at night in the darkness and become worried about their examinations. It also does great harm to our industry. Mills and factories stop working during load shedding, so the production of goods falls and the country suffers a great loss. Load shedding can be reduced in several ways. We should not waste electricity and must use energy-saving bulbs. The government should build more power plants and stop the illegal use of electricity. If we all become careful, this problem can be solved.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Winter Vacation' answering: (a) What is a winter vacation? (b) When does it come? (c) How did you plan it? (d) How did you spend it? (e) How did you feel?
items.model: A winter vacation is a happy period of rest during the winter season. Our school gives a winter vacation of about ten days in the month of December. I waited eagerly for my last winter vacation and made a plan to spend it usefully. I decided to visit my village home and to complete some of my studies. During the vacation I went to my village with my parents. There I enjoyed the calm and quiet beauty of nature. In the morning I walked in the green fields and enjoyed the fresh air. During the day I played with my village friends and helped my grandfather in the garden. In the evening I read storybooks and prepared my lessons. I also enjoyed date juice and pithas made by my grandmother. The days passed very happily, and I felt fresh and cheerful. I shall never forget this pleasant winter vacation.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Nurse' answering: (a) Who is a nurse? (b) Where does she work? (c) What does she do? (d) What qualities should she have? (e) How important is she?
items.model: A nurse is a woman who looks after the sick and the wounded. She is an important member of the medical profession. A nurse works in hospitals, clinics and health centres. Sometimes she also serves patients at their homes. Her main duty is to take care of the patients. She gives them medicine in time, feeds them and keeps them clean and comfortable. She helps the doctors during operations and follows their instructions carefully. A nurse should have some special qualities. She should be kind, patient, sincere and dutiful. She must love her patients and serve them like her own relatives. Florence Nightingale set a bright example of a devoted nurse. The service of a nurse is very important to us. She brings comfort to the suffering people and helps them recover. So, we should honour and respect nurses for their noble service.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে
